summary.lv: Balticom meklē Windows sistēmu administratoru, kurš uzturēs un attīstīs Windows Server infrastruktūru, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Hyper-V virtualizāciju un tīkla servisus vadošajā telekomunikāciju uzņēmumā.
summary.en: Balticom, Latvia's leading telecom, is hiring a Windows System Administrator to manage and develop Windows Server infrastructure, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Hyper-V virtualization, and network services.
